spanish: Plaga de tsaráat cuando fuere en adam, y será traído al sacerdote.

findings.issue: צרעת is a common noun (H6883, feminine singular absolute); «tsaráat» leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
אדם is a common noun (H120, masculine singular) after ב; «adam» leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
כי is only a conjunction; «cuando» selects the temporal sense and closes if, because, and that.

notes: Construct, 3fs imperfect, hophal 3ms, and the definite priest otherwise match the tokens.
